info.title: Organ/Blood Donor–Recipient Matching Network API
info.description: Graph-based matching network backend connecting donors, recipients, and hospitals. [Development Mode: Unauthenticated CRUD operations for Phase 3]

post.description: Authenticates a registered system user using their username and password. Verifies credentials against PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 salted password hashes and issues a signed JWT bearer token. Accepts JSON payload or form.
OAuth2-compatible password form endpoint for Swagger UI Authorization.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's profile and active role from the database. Password hashes are never exposed.

post.description: Registers a new organ/blood donor with location coordinates and viability window. Requires ADMIN or COORDINATOR role.

get.description: Lists donors with pagination and filters for status, organ_type, and blood_type. Accessible by all authenticated roles.
Retrieves a specific donor profile by unique donor_id. Accessible by all authenticated roles.

patch.description: Partially updates donor details and increments version automatically. Requires ADMIN or COORDINATOR role.

delete.description: Deletes a donor if no allocation or match proposal history exists. Requires ADMIN role.

post.description: Registers a new recipient on the waiting list and creates hospital and blood type relationships. Requires ADMIN or COORDINATOR role.

get.description: Lists recipients with pagination and filters for organ, blood type, hospital, and status. Accessible by all authenticated roles.
Retrieves a specific recipient waitlist profile by unique recipient_id. Accessible by all authenticated roles.

patch.description: Partially updates recipient details without allowing direct allocation. Requires ADMIN or COORDINATOR role.

delete.description: Deletes a recipient if no allocation or match history exists. Requires ADMIN role.

patch.description: Updates the recipient's clinical urgency score (1-10) via dedicated endpoint. Requires ADMIN or COORDINATOR role.

post.description: Registers a new hospital with geographical coordinates. Requires ADMIN or COORDINATOR role.

get.description: Lists hospitals with pagination and optional search by name. Accessible by all authenticated roles.
Retrieves a specific hospital by its unique ID. Accessible by all authenticated roles.

patch.description: Partially updates hospital details without breaking relationships. Requires ADMIN or COORDINATOR role.

delete.description: Deletes a hospital if it has no registered recipients, users, or allocation history. Requires ADMIN role.

get.description: Discovers eligible organ/blood donors using Neo4j graph traversal across CAN_DONATE_TO edges, ranks them with deterministic multi-factor scoring (blood, urgency, proximity), and returns an explained, paginated candidate list. Accessible by all authenticated roles.

post.description: Initiates a formal match request linking a candidate donor, waiting recipient, and hospital. Validates eligibility and records the computed match score. Requires ADMIN or COORDINATOR role.

get.description: Lists match requests with pagination and optional status/recipient filters. Accessible by all authenticated roles.
Retrieves a match request record and its linked entities. Accessible by all authenticated roles.

post.description: Executes atomic, concurrency-safe organ allocation for a proposed match request. Requires COORDINATOR or ADMIN role. Verifies donor availability, recipient waiting status, organ type match, and blood compatibility inside a locked Neo4j transaction. Updates Donor to 'Allocated', Recipient to 'Allocated', MatchRequest to 'Confirmed', and creates the Allocation node with (:Donor)-[:ALLOCATED_IN]->(:Allocation), (:Allocation)-[:TO_RECIPIENT]->(:Recipient), and (:Allocation)-[:CONFIRMED_BY]->(:Hospital).

get.description: Retrieves an allocation record by its unique identifier. Accessible by all authenticated roles.
Lists allocation history with pagination and optional filters. Accessible by all authenticated roles.
